fixture_correction.owned_factory: Patch only workers.tasks.Store inside this fixture. Match the exact worker Thread object and assert the exact owned SQLite URL before constructing the real original Store.
fixture_correction.preparation: For transport-ready finite-deadline cases, call the real Store.profile once before deadline construction and discard its returned data. Pass that same Store into execute_operation and assert collector Store identity.
fixture_correction.real_read_retained: The real collector still calls the original Store.profile after the sole deadline starts; no saved profile result, substitute profile, frozen clock or deadline reset is used.
fixture_correction.failure_cleanup: The fixture factory disposes its new engine on preparation error because execute_operation constructs Store before entering its production try/finally. Normal ownership and disposal remain with the production worker.
fixture_correction.unwarmed_controls: Existing cold-SSL and real pre-SSL timeout cases are unchanged and do not use profile preparation. Their original timing semantics remain intact.
